digest.component_or_area: overlap judge / plan review advisory classifier
propositions: overlap judge constructs RunRequest without operation-local output, structured-retry, transport-attempt, or timeout bounds, inheriting generic 16K-token / 600-second policy that permits three sequential generations before safe abstention
malformed overlap responses with runaway candidate_id content consumed 216–311 seconds and multiple retries before triggering advisory abstention, violating documented bounded-classifier intent

token-output ceiling alone does not prevent multiple structured-generation attempts; schema validation alone acts after malformed payload exists; both timeout and retry counts must be lowered before model construction

repair lowers RunRequest with per-request structured-retry, transport-attempt, and timeout seams; applies overlap-local budgets of 1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout
valid six-candidate overlap verdicts retain label-keyed mapping and aggregation behavior under bounded request; existing callers omit limits and preserve prior defaults
bounded abstention path returns exact all-candidate abstention on timeout, truncation, malformed output, or any budget-bound hit, with no fabricated overlap finding
